S01: King Arthur held a rich feast for all his knights.
S02: In the place of honor sat King Arthur.
S03: The hall was full of light, song and laughter.
S04: Suddenly, the great doors swung open with force.
S05: In entered an unknown stranger — all in green, riding a green horse.
S06: He had green skin, green hair and green clothing.
S07: Green Knight: "Who dares strike me with a sword, but then receive a blow from me?"
S08: Silence fell upon the knights — no one dared.
S09: But Gawain, Arthur's nephew, rose and stepped forward.
S11: The Green Knight knelt and offered his neck, and Gawain raised the sword.
S12: But, as if nothing had happened, the knight took back his head.
S13: Green Knight: "I will await you at the Green Chapel in one year and one day."
S14: And as he departed, his head spoke the date of return.
S15: The months passed like leaves on the wind.
S16: The date of the challenge drew ever nearer.
S17: Gawain resolved to set out and keep his word.
S18: The road led him through frozen forests and empty fields.
S19: The days were cold, and the nights colder still.
S20: At the end of the road, out of the evening mist emerged a castle.
S21: The gate was warm and hospitable.
S22: In the courtyard he was welcomed by servants and guests befitting a knight.
S23: Lord: "If you lodge here tonight, tomorrow my servants will lead you to the Green Chapel."
S25: That same evening, the castle honored him with feast and song.
S26: The night passed peacefully, and dawn came quickly.
S27: The next morning, the lord presented him with a parting gift.
S28: Lord: "Take this green girdle. It is magic and will protect you."
S29: The girdle shone with a strange, living light.
S30: Gawain looked upon the gift with wonder and hope.
S31: He tied the girdle around his waist.
S32: The servants brought him his horse, ready to show him the way.
S33: Gawain: "I thank you for the hospitality and for the gift."
S34: And so, Gawain left the hospitable fortress.
S35: The road narrowed and sank ever deeper into the greenwood forest.
S36: One hand rested on the magic girdle.
S37: Far ahead, through the mist, the form of an old church showed itself.
S38: The girdle trembled with light, as if whispering him courage.
S39: In the cold dawn, Gawain arrived before the Green Chapel.
S40: The horse stopped, and Gawain looked toward the stone doors.
S41: The church was silent, wrapped in greenish frosty mist.
S42: Gawain stepped forward, one hand on the sword, the other on the girdle.
S43: The magic girdle glowed, promising him protection.
S44: In the clearing before the church he stood and waited.
S45: No sound, only the wind through the old stones.
S46: But Gawain did not waver — he had come to keep his word.
S47: The doors of the Green Chapel opened of themselves.
S48: With the girdle at his waist, Gawain strides forward toward his destiny.
